rules: Crossover fusions on TS_CORR(ABS($return), $volume, w) fail as 'not a fusion' (only 2 shared nodes) whenever $volume is swapped for another field or the pair gets re-wrapped as CS_RANK(fundamental)*TS_RANK(...) — keep ABS($return) and $volume both intact in the shared subtree and only vary w or add an outer wrapper.

~252-day windows fail coverage at 0.82-0.88 even on pure OHLC fields, not just fundamentals: TS_MEAN($open,63)-TS_MEAN($open,252) over TS_MEAN($high,252)-TS_MEAN($low,252) scored 0.857 coverage — treat ~1yr windows as broadly off-limits regardless of field.

This round's standout accept (11.707) normalizes a close-low position by TS_RANK($dollar_volume,5)+eps rather than raw/derived dollar_volume — try more denominators built on TS_RANK(volume) instead of the volume level itself.

Wrapping $dollar_volume in a ratio (($high/$low)/($dollar_volume+eps)) still hit rho 0.988 against plain TS_MEAN($dollar_volume,21) — a light numerator wrapper does not decorrelate raw dollar_volume; it dominates almost any expression it sits in.

The (price - TS_MIN(w))/(TS_MAX(w)-TS_MIN(w)) position-in-range family failed correlation twice more (rho 0.875, 0.935) from window-only changes (5/21/42) and from a same-shape high-side reframing — saturated across windows, not just at the literal duplicate.

RANK($earnings_per_share) - RANK(TS_DELTA($dollar_volume,63)) scored 4.053, beating the best fundamental-fundamental rank spread on file (3.405) — fundamental-minus-volume-delta spreads look more promising than pure fundamental-fundamental ones; try more.

-TS_DELTA($open,3)/(TS_MEAN($high,21)-TS_MEAN($low,21)+eps) missed cheap_screen narrowly (|t| 0.93 vs 1.00) — short (3d) open-deltas normalized by 21d range are close to signal; retry with a CS_RANK wrapper or adjacent window before dropping the shape.

($open - DELAY($low or $high,1)) constructions keep colliding with Alpha101-family archive members (5-node overlap) — this shape is largely exhausted; only reuse it fused with a clearly distinct fundamental or volume leg.
